# [F] getMinValue | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getminvalue/

# [F] getMinValue

Get the minimum value for a numeric type.
If the value cannot be represented as a JS number(Overflow) undefined will be returned
See [getMinValueAsNumeric](https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getminvalueasnumeric/) to get the precise value

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` |
| `target` | `Type` |

`number` | `undefined`

# [F] getMinValueAsNumeric

    function getMinValueAsNumeric(program, target): Numeric | undefined;

Get the minimum value for a numeric type. If the value cannot be represented as a JS number(Overflow) undefined will be returned

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type
---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)
`target`| [`Type`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/type-aliases/type/)

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

# [F] getMinValueExclusive

Get the minimum value exclusive for a numeric type.
If the value cannot be represented as a JS number(Overflow) undefined will be returned
See [getMinValueExclusiveAsNumeric](https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getminvalueexclusiveasnumeric/) to get the precise value

|---|---|

| `target` | `Type` |

# [F] getMinValueForScalar

    function getMinValueForScalar(program, target): ScalarValue | undefined;

Get the minimum value for a scalar type(datetime, duration, etc.).

# [F] getNamespaceFullName

    function getNamespaceFullName(type, options?): string;

Return the full name of the namespace(e.g. “Foo.Bar”)

# [F] getNormalizedPathComponents | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getnormalizedpathcomponents/

# [F] getNormalizedPathComponents

Parse a path into an array containing a root component (at index 0) and zero or more path
components (at indices > 0). The result is normalized.
If the path is relative, the root component is `""`.
If the path is absolute, the root component includes the first path separator (`/`).

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |
| `currentDirectory` | `string`|`undefined` |

`string`[]

# [F] getParameterVisibilityFilter | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getparametervisibilityfilter/

# [F] getParameterVisibilityFilter

Get the visibility filter that should apply to the parameters of the given operation, or `undefined` if no parameter
visibility is set.

If you are not working in a protocol that has specific implicit visibility semantics, you can use the
[EmptyVisibilityProvider](https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/variables/emptyvisibilityprovider/) as a default provider. If you working in a protocol or context where parameters have
implicit visibility transformations (like HTTP), you should use the visibility provider from that library (for HTTP,
use the `HttpVisibilityProvider` from the `@typespec/http` library).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the Program in which the operation is defined |
| `operation` | `Operation` | the Operation to get the parameter visibility filter for |
| `defaultProvider` | `VisibilityProvider` | a provider for visibility filters that apply when no visibility constraints are explicitly set. Defaults to an empty provider that returns an empty filter if not provided. |

a visibility filter for the parameters of the operation, or `undefined` if no parameter visibility is set

getPathComponents ( "http://typescriptlang.org/path/to/" )  ===  [ "http://typescriptlang.org/" ,  "path" ,  "to" ]

getPathComponents ( "http://typescriptlang.org" )  ===  [ "http://typescriptlang.org" ]

# [F] getPathFromPathComponents

Formats a parsed path consisting of a root component (at index 0) and zero or more path segments (at indices > 0).

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `pathComponents` | readonly `string`[] |

`string`

Formats a parsed path consisting of a root component (at index 0) and zero or more path segments (at indices > 0).

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|

# [F] getPattern | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getpattern/

Gets the pattern regular expression associated with a given type, if one has been set.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the Program containing the target Type |
| `target` | `Type` | the type to get the pattern for |

`string` | `undefined`

the pattern string, if one was set

# [F] getReturnTypeVisibilityFilter | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getreturntypevisibilityfilter/

# [F] getReturnTypeVisibilityFilter

Get the visibility filter that should apply to the return type of the given operation, or `undefined` if no return
type visibility is set.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the Program in which the operation is defined |
| `operation` | `Operation` | the Operation to get the return type visibility filter for |
| `defaultProvider` | `VisibilityProvider` | a provider for visibility filters that apply when no visibility constraints are explicitly set. Defaults to an empty provider that returns an empty filter if not provided. |

a visibility filter for the return type of the operation, or `undefined` if no return type visibility is set

# [F] getReturnsDoc

    function getReturnsDoc(program, target): string | undefined;

Get the documentation string for the return success types of an operation.

Parameter| Type| Description
---|---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)| Program
`target`| [`Operation`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/operation/)| Type

# [F] getReturnsDocData

Get the documentation information for the return success types of an operation. In most cases you probably just want to use [getReturnsDoc](https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getreturnsdoc/)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | Program |
| `target` | `Operation` | Type |

`DocData` | `undefined`

Doc data with source information.

# [F] getVisibilityForClass | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/getvisibilityforclass/

# [F] getVisibilityForClass

Returns the active visibility modifiers for a property in a given visibility class.

This function is infallible. If the visibility modifiers for the given class have not been set explicitly, it will return the default visibility modifiers for the class.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the program in which the property occurs |
| `property` | `ModelProperty` | the property to get visibility modifiers for |
| `visibilityClass` | `Enum` | the visibility class to get visibility modifiers for |

`Set`<[ EnumMember](https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/enummember/)>

the set of active modifiers (enum members) for the property and visibility class

# [F] hasAutoDecorator

    function hasAutoDecorator(

       program,

       decoratorFqn,

       target): boolean;

Check if an auto decorator has been applied to a target.

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type| Description
---|---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)| The current program.
`decoratorFqn`| `string`| The fully-qualified name of the decorator (e.g., “MyLib.myDec”).
`target`| [`Type`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/type-aliases/type/)| The type to check.

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

`boolean`

# [F] hasVisibility | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/hasvisibility/

# [F] hasVisibility

Determines if a property has a specified visibility modifier.

If no visibility modifiers have been set for the visibility class of the modifier, the visibility class’s default modifier set is used.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the program in which the property occurs |
| `property` | `ModelProperty` | the property to check |
| `modifier` | `EnumMember` | the visibility modifier to check for |

`boolean`

true if the property has the visibility modifier, false otherwise

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/ignorediagnostics/

# [F] ignoreDiagnostics

Ignore the diagnostics emitted by the diagnostic accessor pattern and just return the actual result.

| Type Parameter |
|---|
| `T` |

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `result` | <`DiagnosticResult``T`> | Accessor pattern tuple result including the actual result and the list of diagnostics. |

`T`

Actual result.

# [F] isArrayModelType

Check if a model is an array type.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | Program (unused) |
| `type` | `Model` | Model type |

`type is ArrayModelType`

Use `isArrayModelType(type)` instead. The `program` parameter is unused.

Check if a model is an array type.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `Model` | Model type |

# [F] isDeclaredType

    function isDeclaredType(type): boolean;

Check if the type is a declared type. This include:

  * non templated type
  * template declaration

# [F] isErrorModel

    function isErrorModel(program, target): boolean;

Check if the type is an error model or a descendant of an error model.

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type
---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)
`target`| [`Type`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/type-aliases/type/)

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

`boolean`

# [F] isGlobalNamespace

    function isGlobalNamespace(program, namespace): namespace is Namespace & { name: ""; namespace: undefined };

Check if the given namespace is the global namespace

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type| Description
---|---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)| Program
`namespace`| [`Namespace`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/namespace/)| Namespace

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

`namespace is Namespace & { name: ""; namespace: undefined }`

# [F] isNumeric

    function isNumeric(arg): arg is Numeric;

Check if the given arg is a Numeric

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type
---|---
`arg`| `unknown`

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

`arg is Numeric`

# [F] isRecordModelType | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/isrecordmodeltype/

# [F] isRecordModelType

Check if a model is a record type.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | Program (unused) |
| `type` | `Model` | Model type |

`type is RecordModelType`

Use `isRecordModelType(type)` instead. The `program` parameter is unused.

Check if a model is a record type.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `Model` | Model type |

`type is RecordModelType`

# [F] isSealed | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/issealed/

# [F] isSealed

Check if a property has had its visibility modifiers sealed.

If the property has been sealed globally, this function will return true. If the property has been sealed for the given visibility class, this function will return true.

Otherwise, this function returns false.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | - |
| `property` | `ModelProperty` | the property to check |
| `visibilityClass?` | `Enum` | the optional visibility class to check |

`boolean`

true if the property is sealed for the given visibility class, false otherwise

# [F] isService

    function isService(program, namespace): boolean;

Check if the namespace is defined as a service.

# [F] isTypeSpecValueTypeOf | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/istypespecvaluetypeof/

# [F] isTypeSpecValueTypeOf

Check if the given target is of any of the TypeSpec types.

| Type Parameter |
|---|
| `K`extends`TypeKind` |

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | `TypeSpecValue` | Target to validate. |
| `expectedType` | `K`| readonly`K`[] | One or multiple allowed TypeSpec types. |

`target is InferredTypeSpecValue<K>`

boolean if the target is of one of the allowed types.

# [F] isUrl | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/isurl/

# [F] isUrl

Determines whether a path starts with a URL scheme (e.g. starts with `http://`, `ftp://`, `file://`, etc.).

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |

`boolean`

Determines whether a path starts with a URL scheme (e.g. starts with `http://`, `ftp://`, `file://`, etc.).

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `path` | `string` |

`boolean`

# [F] isVisible | TypeSpec

Source: https://typespec.io/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/functions/isvisible/

# [F] isVisible

Determines if a property is visible according to the given visibility filter.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `Program` | the program in which the property occurs |
| `property` | `ModelProperty` | the property to check |
| `filter` | `VisibilityFilter` | the visibility filter to use |

`boolean`

true if the property is visible according to the filter, false otherwise

VisibilityFilter

# [F] joinPaths

# [F] listServices

    function listServices(program): Service[];

List all the services defined in the TypeSpec program

## Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”

Parameter| Type| Description
---|---|---
`program`| [`Program`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/program/)| Program

## Returns

Section titled “Returns”

[`Service`](/docs/standard-library/reference/js-api/interfaces/service/)[]

List of service.
